### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-03T18:11:03Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical — test-only: one new component spec; no source, config or contract change.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The spec covers three behaviours of `form.field.FileUpload`: the ready state (input/label id link, `Choose file`), an existing downloadable document (the download `href` built through `createUrl`'s `{documentId}` token, `2.5KB`, the deleted state, reset through the action button), and client-side validation of extension and `maxSize` through the real file input (`setInputFiles`). Checked against `src/form/field/FileUpload.mjs` on `dev`: the selectors match the vdom (lines 125–133), the strings match the locale configs (340–355), and the URL token matches `createUrl` (804). At `f5e9977b11` the CI components shard ran all three tests and they pass. Setup and teardown follow the `Email` / `Switch` siblings. I looked for an instance leaking between tests (`afterEach` destroys it), an assertion that passes on an empty match (each one checks a class, text or attribute value, so a miss times out), and a `downloadUrl` that passes by accident (`{documentId}` is the implemented token), and found none.

**Findings:** None in this diff. Noticed in passing: the class's own JSDoc examples (lines 232, 254, 294) write `${documentId}`, which `createUrl` turns into `/getDocument/$42`. Your spec uses the working form. I sent it as a defect-note; it is outside this PR.
